description: This file defines an interface for a service related to credit bureau loan product mappings within the Fineract infrastructure. It declares methods for adding and updating credit bureau loan product mappings.

classes.name: CreditBureauLoanProductMappingWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for adding and updating credit bureau loan product mappings.

methods.name: addCreditBureauLoanProductMapping
methods.description: Creates a new mapping between a credit bureau and a loan product, given the credit bureau ID and a command object.

methods.name: updateCreditBureauLoanProductMapping
methods.description: Updates an existing credit bureau loan product mapping based on the provided command object.
